semantic.justification: Original public default-package bundle API now uses actual cached entries, raw aliases, result/path initialization and close/copy ownership. No resolved keyTypeData projection substitutes for dynamic alias resolution. Stored size/cursor, raw zero-token stack state, canonical C keys, scalar type/error/length asymmetries including CALC-312, source alias temporaries, iterator ordering and valid/actual locale identities are preserved. Module reexports the one owner from uresimp and source lifecycle/fallback functions, without dual legacy/new implementations. The unchanged ICU78.3 uresbund.cpp public witness passes19888 queries: all982 direct package opens, all996 raw alias occurrences from root/keyTypeData, default/parent/root/direct and fill-in open modes, sticky failures, valid/actual identities, complete content digests, every initialized inline/path byte, long heap paths and the63-byte threshold, source alias-depth boundaries, scalar/iterator/copy state, same-handle/fill-in reuse and retained parent/pool references, plus756 actual ResourceDataValue data/valid-locale context cases. Source-valid narrow/count ranges and the pinned immutable default package are the certified projection; physical allocator/OOM/ABI/freed-pointer states and other packages remain uncertified. Internal ures_getValueWithFallback preserves sticky/nullable-path behavior and attaches the original raw data/valid-locale/resource context to the caller ResourceDataValue through its persistent temporary. Empty C paths borrow the original bundle without changing that temporary;756 native comparisons cover holder context and unchanged failed outputs.
